queries.query: Gaithersburg Maryland official GIS parcel map ArcGIS
queries.result: Found the official City of Gaithersburg Maps / GIS page, which links Address & Parcel Info and Open GIS Data.

queries.query: Gaithersburg Maryland official cadastral parcel data GIS
queries.result: Found the official City parcel viewer documentation and the City-hosted ArcGIS REST parcel layer; the documentation states parcel boundaries are maintained by City staff and attribute information comes from Maryland SDAT.

source.name: City of Gaithersburg GIS / MyGaithersburg ArcGIS REST service

attempts.route: City GIS page and official open-data portal
attempts.outcome: Succeeded; official parcel viewer/open-data links identified.

attempts.route: ArcGIS REST layer metadata GET with f=pjson
attempts.outcome: Succeeded; polygon layer, schema, extent, native WKID 2893, and GeoJSON support observed. Schema contains additional unsafe fields, which were not retained.

attempts.route: Anonymous bounded query where=1=1, outFields=fullacctno, returnGeometry=true, resultRecordCount=3, outSR=4326, f=geojson
attempts.outcome: Succeeded; three full parcel polygons returned and retained with only canonical id properties.

attempts.route: Anonymous exact-point intersects query at the immutable WUP point, inSR=4326, returnGeometry=false
attempts.outcome: Succeeded with zero features. This is an exact-point miss only and is not evidence of citywide absence.

qualification.citywideCoverage: The service metadata extent and City description support municipal parcel coverage, but this audit did not download or validate the complete citywide dataset.
qualification.identityProvenance: The retained ids are the native fullacctno field values returned by the service; no synthetic row numbers were used.
qualification.geometryProvenance: Retained geometries are unchanged GeoJSON geometries returned by the service after requesting outSR=4326.
uncertainty: Exact WUP point falls outside a returned parcel despite being within the service extent; no inference of absence is made.
No adapter integration or serial reviewer qualification was performed.
